complete_source_units.text: On day one of the seventh month they began offering whole burnt offerings to the Lord, though the Lord’s house had not been founded.
The people could not distinguish the sound of the joyful signal from the sound of the people’s weeping, for the people cried out with a loud voice, and the sound was heard far away.

In the days of Arthasastha, Tabeel, together with the rest of his fellow slaves, wrote in peace for Mithradates to Arthasastha king of the Persians. The tax collector wrote a document in Syrian, and it was interpreted.

I have also issued a decision: for anyone who changes this word, a timber will be taken down from his house, and he will be raised upright and fastened upon it. His house will be dealt with according to me.
He has been sent from the king and the seven advisers to inspect Judea and Jerusalem by the law of their God that is in your hand,

It has also been made known to you: from any priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, Nathinim or ministers of this house of God, let there be no tax for you; you shall have no authority to enslave them.
